visible_content: {"issues":[{"claim_span_id":"claim-run-370d340d-cc85-4520-aaff-e227c8bd93bb-1","status":"conflict","nature":"confirmed_conflict","category":"event_status","severity":"high","explanation":"上午10点整，清单尚未签署、船仍停在果园码头，因此该船此刻并未完成下水。","reasoning":"该主张把下水完成定在「10点 on the same day」。证据 span-...-4 是 static_canon 规则，规定只有在清单签署且船离开果园码头之后才算完成，它界定的是被断言的结果，因此只是前提。证据 span-...-5 用同一时间锚「10点 on the same day」记录：那一分钟内清单仍未签署、船始终停在码头且未离开。按该规则，这两个必要条件的当时均未满足，所以主张的完成状态与证据在同一时间、同一对象上无法并存。类别取 event_status，因为决定性事实是下水是否已完成，规则仅定义完成含义。","temporal_basis":{"claim_anchor":"10点 on the same day","evidence_anchor":"10点 on the same day","relation":"explicit_overlap"},"evidence":[{"chapter_id":"fixture-chapter-orchard_restoration-4","span_id":"fixture-span-orchard_restoration-4","relation":"context","sufficiency":"sufficient","related_memory_ids":["fixture-memory-orchard_restoration-4"]},{"chapter_id":"fixture-chapter-orchard_restoration-5","span_id":"fixture-span-orchard_restoration-5","relation":"contradicts","sufficiency":"sufficient","related_memory_ids":["fixture-memory-orchard_restoration-5"]}],"evidence_chain":[{"span_id":"fixture-span-orchard_restoration-4","role":"prior_state"},{"span_id":"fixture-span-orchard_restoration-5","role":"current_context"}],"suggested_revision":{"before":"At 10点 on the same day, the restoration boat had completed its launch.","after":"At 10点 on the same day, the restoration boat's launch had not been completed: its manifest was still unsigned and the boat had not left the orchard quay."},"available_actions":["edit","apply_suggestion","keep_intentional","false_positive"]}],"claim_verdicts":[{"claim_span_id":"claim-run-370d340d-cc85-4520-aaff-e227c8bd93bb-1","verdict":"reviewed_issue","basis":"主张称10点当天该船已完成下水，而同一时间锚的证据显示清单未签、船未离码头；结合规则中完成所需的两个条件，二者不能并存，故成立冲突（event_status）。"}]}
